actionLangCode.description: The text to show, will be used in the form of Lang.Get(ActionLangCode)

mouseButton.description: What mouse button should be used for this interaction?

hotKeyCode.description: Does it require a mouse modifier key to perform this action (e.g. "shift" or "ctrl")

hotKeyCodes.description: Does it require pressing multiple keys to perform this action (if set then HotkeyCode is ignored)

itemStacks.description: Does the player need to hold a certain items/blocks in hands? (e.g. a knife). You can define an array of item stacks here and the game will loop through them in a 1 second interval. This property is loaded from the entitytypes and blocktype json files and then resolved.
